propositions: Codex sessions invoke ambient Ruff and skip mypy instead of using repository-managed tools, misrepresenting quality gate status.
The documented local development workflow (docs/local-dev-env.md) defines the authoritative environment bootstrap, but Codex guidance did not reference or require it.
AGENTS.md must instruct Codex to prepend the current worktree .venv/bin to PATH before running development commands (make lint, make typecheck, make rebar).
When the repository virtual environment is correctly activated via PATH prepending, both make lint and make typecheck exit zero with expected outputs.
Gerrit change 869 adds Codex-facing AGENTS.md guidance citing docs/local-dev-env.md and verified in isolated worktrees using per-command PATH configuration.
